summary: 10 film announcements, 7 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Leprechaun
film.announcement: New horror movie in development from Lionsgate with writers Patrick Melton and Marcus Dunstan attached.

film.title: The Legend of Zelda
film.announcement: Actress Lydia Peckham added to cast of the live-action film adaptation.

film.title: Drifter
film.talent: Kate Beckinsale, Dermot Mulroney, Robert Knepper, Sticky Fingaz (cast)
film.announcement: Action-thriller film casts Kate Beckinsale, Dermot Mulroney, Robert Knepper, and rapper Sticky Fingaz.

film.title: Nickels
film.announcement: Briarcliff Entertainment sets fall theatrical and PVOD release for supernatural drama starring Rob Riggle.

film.title: Blur
film.announcement: Director Kirill Sokolov is tackling sci-fi action movie for Netflix.

film.title: Crawl 2
film.announcement: Paramount greenlights sequel to Crawl with Mason Gooding and Emily Rudd starring.

film.title: Dedicated to Morris Burke
film.announcement: Da'Vine Joy Randolph stars in indie dark comedy directed by Will Ropp.

film.title: Everything Else Is Noise
film.announcement: Pragda acquires distribution rights to Nicolás Pereda's film ahead of Toronto and New York Film Festival premieres.

film.title: Wonka 2
film.announcement: Warner Bros. and screenwriter clarify that Wonka 2 is not delayed indefinitely.

film.title: The Gallerist
film.announcement: Sundance 2026 film featuring Natalie Portman and Jenna Ortega acquired by Roadside Attractions and Vertical.

tv.title: Sherlock's Secretary
tv.announcement: Creator Andy Berman from Psych eyes return to USA Network with new procedural drama in development.

tv.title: Heated Rivalry
tv.announcement: Season 2 casts Justice Smith and Charlie Gillespie as Harris and Troy; Spring 2027 debut confirmed.

tv.title: New York Yankees Drama Series
tv.talent: Jason Bateman (Aggregate Films), Josh Wakely, MLB (involved)
tv.announcement: Netflix develops drama series about the New York Yankees from Jason Bateman's Aggregate Films, Josh Wakely, and MLB.

tv.title: Descendants: Hidden Heroes
tv.announcement: Disney expands Descendants universe with new film following children of sidekicks from Aladdin, The Emperor's New Groove, and other films.

tv.title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives
tv.announcement: Series receives 20-episode renewal after Taylor Frankie Paul drama.

tv.title: Ted Lasso
tv.announcement: Season 4 features women's sports storyline as key element bringing back the hit series.

tv.title: Paradise
tv.announcement: Director Hanelle M. Culpepper discusses Season 2 finale of sci-fi series.
